title: elegant juicy ukrainian turkey neck pilaf
description: a hearty, shojin-friendly pilaf dish from ukraine, featuring turkey neck and a rich, savory mother sauce base

ingredients.name: dried thyme
ingredients.notes: fresh or dried thyme works well in this dish

ingredients.name: white wine vinegar
ingredients.notes: optional, but adds depth of flavor

instructions: heat the butter in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
add the caraway seeds and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
add the turkey neck and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
add the arborio rice and stir to combine with the onion mixture.
add the chicken broth, 1 cup at a time, stirring constantly and allowing each cup to absorb before adding the next.
bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the turkey is tender.
stir in the dried thyme and white wine vinegar (if using).
season the pilaf with salt and pepper to taste.
serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
